digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry
propositions: Define a narrow factory protocol and immutable route registry that describe routes and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.
Implement deterministic CLI help formatting (fixed width, UTF-8 LF, trailing newline) and compatibility-preserving parse errors via extended argparse customization.
Validate route registry for duplicate spellings, alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, and malformed references without resolving handlers.
Derive legacy policy-set exports from routes and confirm shadow-parity against current command sets without cutting over help or execution.
Prove via import blockers and subprocess isolation that registry construction and route lookup do not import handlers or optional packages like pydantic_ai.
